evals.name: webapp-topology
evals.prompt: Make me an editable excalidraw diagram of a standard web app: users hit CloudFront, which goes to an ALB (load balancer), which fans out to 3 EC2 API servers, and those read/write a Postgres RDS plus an ElastiCache Redis. I want to be able to drag the boxes around afterward.
evals.expected_output: A .excalidraw file with boxes for users/CloudFront/ALB/3 API servers/Postgres/Redis and bound arrows showing the flow; opens in excalidraw.com and boxes stay connected when dragged.

assertions.text: Output is a .excalidraw file that parses as JSON with top-level type 'excalidraw'
Contains at least 6 rectangles and at least 5 arrows
Every arrow is two-way bound (startBinding+endBinding to existing boxes, reciprocal in boundElements)
No arrow endpoint sits inside its bound box (won't detach on drag)
Box text covers the named components: CloudFront, ALB/load balancer, API, Postgres, Redis
All text elements use a single fontFamily

evals.name: data-pipeline
evals.prompt: Can you draw our data pipeline in excalidraw so I can edit it? Events come in through Kafka, Flink processes them and writes parquet to S3. Separately, Airflow kicks off nightly dbt runs that load Snowflake, and Snowflake feeds a Looker dashboard.
evals.expected_output: A .excalidraw file mapping Kafka->Flink->S3 and Airflow->dbt->Snowflake->Looker with bound arrows; editable.

assertions.text: Output is a .excalidraw file that parses as JSON with top-level type 'excalidraw'
Contains at least 6 rectangles and at least 5 arrows
Every arrow is two-way bound (startBinding+endBinding to existing boxes, reciprocal in boundElements)
No arrow endpoint sits inside its bound box (won't detach on drag)
Box text covers: Kafka, Flink, S3, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, Looker
All text elements use a single fontFamily

evals.name: microservices-flow
evals.prompt: I sketched our backend on a whiteboard, turn it into an excalidraw file: an API gateway routes to an auth service, a user service, and a billing service. Auth and user both read the main Postgres. Billing calls the Stripe API and also writes to Postgres.
evals.expected_output: A .excalidraw file: API gateway -> auth/user/billing; auth+user -> Postgres; billing -> Stripe and Postgres; bound arrows, editable.

assertions.text: Output is a .excalidraw file that parses as JSON with top-level type 'excalidraw'
Contains at least 6 rectangles and at least 6 arrows
Every arrow is two-way bound (startBinding+endBinding to existing boxes, reciprocal in boundElements)
No arrow endpoint sits inside its bound box (won't detach on drag)
Box text covers: API gateway, auth, user, billing, Postgres, Stripe
All text elements use a single fontFamily
